pins.title: Blackout vs Room-Darkening Curtains: Read the Label Before Day Sleep
pins.subtitle: Dim is not the same as dark
pins.description: Room-darkening curtains leave a room dim, which may be fine for a nap but often not for a full day of sleep after a night shift. Blackout curtains use denser or coated fabric. Thermal curtains may or may not carry a blackout rating. Plus a simple sunny-day test to tell a fabric problem from an edge leak. Not medical advice. #blackoutcurtains #daysleeper #nightshift #shiftworksleep #darkbedroom

pins.title: Sleep Mask Not Sealing? 3 Signs It Doesn't Fit Your Face (Day Sleepers)
pins.subtitle: Light at the nose, tight strap, slipping
pins.description: Seeing light at the bridge of your nose or cheekbones, pulling the strap tight just to keep it on, or a mask that slides when you turn onto your side are all signs of a poor fit. A contoured design with adjustable cups is the usual next step, and side sleepers may do better with a slimmer profile. Eye condition or recent eye surgery? Ask a doctor first. Not medical advice. #sleepmask #daysleeper #shiftwork #sidesleeper
